How to explore the rhizome

  1. The opening view connects Boulder, Colorado to every international exhibition in this archive.
  2. Click on a glowing location to see every Artnauts exhibition held there.
  3. Select an exhibition to see its participating artists.
  4. Click on an artist to reveal their rhizome across every other location where they appeared.
